note: Bundle row roster — the single source for the three cordis.patch.yml files (all/host/preset). `forms` is row membership inside the `- insert:` section (the field a maintainer edits to move a row between install forms); a row body and its lead comments are verbatim text, stored once when the forms share them and per form when they differ. Group banners are verbatim per form (their wording is form-specific). Everything outside the insert section (the top-level override blocks) is verbatim per form in `tail`. Rendered by gen-bundle-patches.mjs; a hand edit of a generated patch is drift.

header: # Full-functionality evolution bundle (DEFAULT install target).
# This layer = evolution-host's entire infrastructure plane ∪ the four
# agent-preset-class model tool rows (tool-memory / tool-skill-manage /
# tool-session-query / evolution-skill-catalog), all mounted at PROFILE-ROOT
# level: installing
# @lmzhen/dsh-evolution-all is the default "most complete first" path — every
# session gets the automation AND the memory/skill tools AND the
# SKILLS/MEMORY guidance injection, with no agent-preset step.
# (v20 wording: the host plane inside this bundle also carries the read-only
# `maintenance_probe` schema via its evolution-maintenance-tools row — a
# fifth model-visible surface beyond the four rows above.)
# THREE-WAY DRIFT GUARD (evolution-host/tests/bundle-mutual-exclusion.spec.ts):
#   - every infra row block below must stay byte-identical to
#     evolution-host/cordis.patch.yml (same id/name/config/disabled);
#   - the four model rows must stay byte-identical to
#     evolution-preset/cordis.patch.yml's model rows;
#   - the row names must all resolve inside this package's dependency closure.
# MUTUAL EXCLUSION: all / host / one-click preset are ALTERNATIVE install
# targets — mounting two of them triple-mounts the infra rows and fails loud
# at startup (invariants: already registered). `all` is likewise exclusive
# with the layered Evolution agent preset (the preset scope's model rows would
# double-mount the tools). Single install only.
tail: # ── cross-session recall: enable the native session-query index ─────────────
# `tool-session-query` (above) exposes `session_search`; this overlay
# enables the backing SQLite full-text index so that search actually works.
# It is a configuration OVERRIDE of the base `session-query-sqlite` row (never
# an insert — base already provides it), so it must sit OUTSIDE the `- insert:`
# block above. Both fields are parameterized via environment variables (dsh
# `!!js` runtime evaluation), and any profile cordis.patch.yml overlay may still
# override them later. `openAt` defaults to `startup` so the index is ready for
# cross-session recall; set `DSH_EVOLUTION_SESSION_QUERY=never` to disable, or
# `first-search` to build it lazily. A durable `path` (not `:memory:`) lets the
# index survive restarts. Note: `config` values replace the base entry's config
# wholesale, so both path and openAt are set here.
# WHOLE-CONFIG REPLACEMENT (v33 G2.3): an override's `config` replaces the base
# entry's config as a whole, so every platform key NOT set below falls back to
# that row's schema default. Platform keys for this row
# (0.1.5-rc.2 `session-query-sqlite` Config): path, openAt, journalMode,
# defaultLimit, maxLimit, snippetChars, readWindowMax, persistedReadConcurrency,
# preparedSessionCacheSize.
# verify-declared-config.mjs --upstream recomputes this list from the platform
# source and fails when the row gains a key this comment does not name.
- id: session-query-sqlite
config:
# P2-12 (V10-15): `??` only catches null/undefined, so a set-but-EMPTY
# variable kept the empty string and `resolve('')` dropped the SQLite
# index into the process CWD. The three-part form trims the value first;
# only a non-empty path overrides the durable default.
path: !!js (process.env.DSH_EVOLUTION_SESSION_QUERY_PATH || '').trim() || dshHomePath('evolution', 'session-query.db')
# P2-13 (V10-15): whitelist normalization — an arbitrary invalid value used
# to reach the platform z.union schema and blow up the whole profile at
# startup with an error far from the root cause. Unknown/empty values fall
# back to 'startup'. (Quoted scalar: the ternary's `: ` would otherwise
# break YAML plain-scalar parsing — see the upstream `!!js "..."` forms.)
openAt: !!js "['startup', 'first-search', 'never'].includes(process.env.DSH_EVOLUTION_SESSION_QUERY) ? process.env.DSH_EVOLUTION_SESSION_QUERY : 'startup'"
# ── Hermes 60-char catalog rule: platform interface, deployment default ──────
# Upstream tool-skill exposes `catalogDescriptionMaxLength` (the 500 constant is
# only the schema default); the Hermes authoring standard is 60 and the index
# truncates at the configured value.
# REACH (P1-2 / V10-14, corrected): this override is a PROFILE-ROOT row, so it
# covers sessions mounted WITHOUT an agent preset only. Sessions running under
# an agent preset read the preset scope's own `tool-skill` row, which no
# profile patch can touch — for those, the preset composer injects the same cap
# at generation time (V10-14 → 0.3.53), and the one-click preset patch carries
# the identical root-level override.
# Base `tool-skill` row carries no other config today, so the whole-config
# replacement is safe; if upstream adds fields there, copy them.
# WHOLE-CONFIG REPLACEMENT (v33 G2.3): an override's `config` replaces the base
# entry's config as a whole, so every platform key NOT set below falls back to
# that row's schema default. Platform keys for this row (0.1.5-rc.2
# `tool-skill` Config): catalogDescriptionMaxLength.
# verify-declared-config.mjs --upstream recomputes this list from the platform
# source and fails when the row gains a key this comment does not name.
# OPT-29 (2026-09): on the WEB plane the upstream web-app patch disables the
# profile-root tool-skill row entirely (web-app/cordis.patch.yml: tool-skill
# disabled: true) — there this override patches an entry that never starts.
# That is harmless today (root sessions on web have no skill tool at all), and
# preset-scope sessions are covered by the composer injection; the override
# reaches base-plane (headless) root sessions only.
- id: tool-skill
config:
catalogDescriptionMaxLength: 60

header: # Recommended native dsh-evolution composition (bundle patch form).
# This file is a DSH bundle PATCH: it inserts the evolution rows into the
# profile's empty root composition and therefore uses the loader's
# `- insert:` patch vocabulary, not the top-level entry list of cordis.yml.
# The storage stack (`storage`, `storage-json`, `storage-domain`) is
# HOST-plane in DSH, exactly like session persistence and the native approval
# stack. A preset must not own it. `evolution-state-domain` below joins the
# host's storage-domain facility when present; `evolution-state-json` is the
# portable alternative — there is NO automatic fallback between providers
# (P2-6): the effective one is whichever registered first unless a profile
# overlay pins `config: { provider: ... }` on the `evolution-state` row.
tail: # ── cross-session recall: enable the native session-query index ─────────────
# Mirrors evolution-host: this is an OVERRIDE of the base `session-query-sqlite`
# row (never an insert) so it sits OUTSIDE the `- insert:` block. Parameterized
# via dsh `!!js` runtime env evaluation; profile overlays may still override.
# WHOLE-CONFIG REPLACEMENT (v33 G2.3): an override's `config` replaces the base
# entry's config as a whole, so every platform key NOT set below falls back to
# that row's schema default. Platform keys for this row
# (0.1.5-rc.2 `session-query-sqlite` Config): path, openAt, journalMode,
# defaultLimit, maxLimit, snippetChars, readWindowMax, persistedReadConcurrency,
# preparedSessionCacheSize.
# verify-declared-config.mjs --upstream recomputes this list from the platform
# source and fails when the row gains a key this comment does not name.
- id: session-query-sqlite
config:
# P2-12 (V10-15): trim-then-fallback — an empty DSH_EVOLUTION_SESSION_
# QUERY_PATH used to resolve the SQLite index into the process CWD (see
# the host patch for the full note; keep the two expressions identical).
path: !!js (process.env.DSH_EVOLUTION_SESSION_QUERY_PATH || '').trim() || dshHomePath('evolution', 'session-query.db')
# P2-13 (V10-15): whitelist normalization instead of feeding any raw value
# to the platform z.union schema (see the host patch for the full note).
openAt: !!js "['startup', 'first-search', 'never'].includes(process.env.DSH_EVOLUTION_SESSION_QUERY) ? process.env.DSH_EVOLUTION_SESSION_QUERY : 'startup'"
# ── Hermes 60-char catalog cap: same root-level override the host carries ────
# Upstream tool-skill exposes `catalogDescriptionMaxLength` (the 500 constant is
# only the schema default); the Hermes authoring standard is 60.
# REACH (P1-2 / V10-14): this override is a PROFILE-ROOT row, so it covers
# sessions mounted WITHOUT an agent preset. Sessions running under an agent
# preset (the default one-click setup boots the platform's standard preset)
# read the preset scope's own `tool-skill` row, which NO profile patch — this
# bundle's included — can touch; the layered flow covers those by injecting
# the cap onto the standard-sourced preset row at install time
# (install-layered.mjs, V10-14). Carrying the row here keeps the one-click
# form at parity with the host bundle instead of shipping no cap anywhere.
# The row is byte-identical to the host's, so the E-33 shared-row pin
# (bundle-mutual-exclusion spec) holds; base `tool-skill` carries no other
# config today, so the whole-config replacement is safe.
# WHOLE-CONFIG REPLACEMENT (v33 G2.3): an override's `config` replaces the base
# entry's config as a whole, so every platform key NOT set below falls back to
# that row's schema default. Platform keys for this row (0.1.5-rc.2
# `tool-skill` Config): catalogDescriptionMaxLength.
# verify-declared-config.mjs --upstream recomputes this list from the platform
# source and fails when the row gains a key this comment does not name.
# OPT-29 (2026-09): on the WEB plane the upstream web-app patch disables the
# profile-root tool-skill row entirely (web-app/cordis.patch.yml: tool-skill
# disabled: true) — there this override patches an entry that never starts.
# That is harmless today (root sessions on web have no skill tool at all), and
# preset-scope sessions are covered by the composer injection; the override
# reaches base-plane (headless) root sessions only.
- id: tool-skill
config:
catalogDescriptionMaxLength: 60

body: # The storage-domain provider is opt-in. It is disabled by default so a
# profile without the host storage-domain facility boots deterministically
# and evolution-state-json remains the active portable backend. Enable it
# explicitly in a profile overlay only when storage-domain is mounted.
# S1-D1 (0.3.80): json medium PINNED explicitly — byte-identical to the
# host bundle's row (three-way drift guard). See that file for the full
# rationale: the unpinned row let a domain-enabling overlay silently
# switch the family's state medium to an empty domain.

all: name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-evolution-state'
# S1-D1 (0.3.80): json medium PINNED explicitly — byte-identical to the
# host bundle's row (three-way drift guard). See that file for the full
# rationale: the unpinned row let a domain-enabling overlay silently
# switch the family's state medium to an empty domain.
config:
provider: json
host: name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-evolution-state'
# S1-D1 (0.3.80): the medium is PINNED explicitly. The row used to carry
# no pin on purpose (V10-16): the registry has NO fallback, so the
# effective provider was whichever row registered first — json while the
# domain row above stays `disabled: true`, but any overlay that merely
# ENABLED the domain row silently switched the family's whole state
# medium to an empty domain (pending list blank, approvals unresolvable,
# historical json state invisible) with a single ambiguous-provider warn
# as the only signal. The pin makes json the deterministic shipped
# default; switching to domain is a deliberate overlay override of THIS
# row's config (`provider: domain` — the config replaces wholesale).
config:
provider: json
preset: name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-evolution-state'
# S1-D1 (0.3.80): json medium PINNED explicitly — byte-identical to the
# host bundle's row (three-way drift guard). See that file for the full
# rationale: the unpinned row let a domain-enabling overlay silently
# switch the family's state medium to an empty domain.
config:
provider: json

lead: # row); with the model rows at profile root every session carries them.

all: # `sessionScoped: true` is shared with evolution-host/preset (byte-identical
# row); with the model rows at profile root every session carries them.
host: # `sessionScoped: true`: the family observes only the sessions that carry
# its model tools. The shipped bundles all set it — mounted at profile root
# that is every session, inside a variant preset only the ones that selected
# it. See evolution-core/src/opt-in.ts.
# S0-4 (v43 G-1 / J-1): in the HOST-ONLY form the premise fails — this bundle
# mounts NO model tool row (tool-memory / tool-skill-manage are
# devDependencies), so the probe matches no session and BOTH this row and
# evolution-review below go inert. The row stays enabled: what was missing was
# the diagnosis, not the gate. It is no longer silent — the gate leaves one
# warn per process, and `/evolution doctor` prints
# `scoped rows: evolution-review=on/skill-usage=on, probe=never-hit` with the
# host-only and variant readings spelled out.
preset: # `sessionScoped: true` is shared with evolution-host/all (this row must stay
# byte-identical across the bundles — bundle-mutual-exclusion.spec). Here the
# model rows are mounted at profile root, so every session carries them.

lead: # S3-1 (G-3) LAYER SEMANTICS: this row files into the GLOBAL layer (profile
# root). It governs sessions WITHOUT the Evolution agent preset; with the
# preset active, the preset layer is NEARER and wins a duplicate name
# outright — rank does not cross layers (packages/skill/skill/src/index.ts:
# "the nearest layer's entry wins a duplicate name outright, and the rank
# order decides duplicates only within one layer"). So `includeSkillNames` /
# `excludeSkillNames` set HERE have no effect on a preset session: set them on
# the preset's row (evolution-preset/cordis.yml) for those sessions, and
# install ONE form (doctor flags all + layered preset as a double-mount).

body: # The DSH tool catalog exposes the plain `skill` tool only — the
# `skill_search`/`skill_load` discovery pair does not exist here, so
# listing it would be dead configuration. Allow `skill` so review
# subagents can load skills under the Anchored Standard preset family.
# Shared with host/preset (byte-identical row); the model rows are at
# profile root here, so every session carries them.

all: name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-evolution-review'
config:
# The DSH tool catalog exposes the plain `skill` tool only — the
# `skill_search`/`skill_load` discovery pair does not exist here, so
# listing it would be dead configuration. Allow `skill` so review
# subagents can load skills under the Anchored Standard preset family.
reviewToolAllow: [skill]
# Shared with host/preset (byte-identical row); the model rows are at
# profile root here, so every session carries them.
sessionScoped: true
host: name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-evolution-review'
config:
# The DSH tool catalog exposes the plain `skill` tool only — the
# `skill_search`/`skill_load` discovery pair does not exist here, so
# listing it would be dead configuration. Allow `skill` so review
# subagents can load skills under the Anchored Standard preset family.
reviewToolAllow: [skill]
# See the skill-usage row above: an original-preset session under a
# variant install carries no family tools and must not be injected. The
# host-only caveat there applies here too — a probe that never matches is
# reported by the gate's one-time warn and by `/evolution doctor`
# (S0-4 / v43 G-1), never inferred from a silent skip.
sessionScoped: true
preset: name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-evolution-review'
config:
# Mirror evolution-host: the DSH tool catalog exposes the plain `skill`
# tool only, so review subagents load skills through it. Keeping the
# shared-row config byte-identical to host preserves the mutual exclusion
# between the host bundle and this preset bundle (E-33).
reviewToolAllow: [skill]
# Shared with every bundle (byte-identical row): with the model rows at
# profile root every session carries them, so the probe passes for all.
sessionScoped: true
